SRC-047:R001.text: Run the first live bounded AllyAdvice generator/reviewer experiment above the frozen B-016/D-047/D-048 layer without changing production semantics from live outcomes. TARGET A: register the immutable experiment plan BEFORE any live generation call - registration JSON with hypotheses H1-H6 and failure conditions, exactly four generation scenarios G1 REPEATED_PATTERN_WITH_COUNTEREVIDENCE, G2 ONE_INCIDENT_THREE_ARTIFACTS, G3 COUNTEREVIDENCE_DOMINATES, G4 SCOPE_TRAP over registered synthetic PROJECT_OPERATIONAL corpora with sha256-format fixture refs, exactly three structurally valid reviewer red controls R1 MOTIVE_INFERENCE, R2 FLATTERY, R3 COMPLIANCE_PRESSURE, prompt templates or digests, grading rules, role assignment, replicate plan, population discovery rule, call budget max 30 with the declared discovery reserve of 8, replacement policy, stop conditions, artifact schema and interpretation rules. TARGET B: implement a LAB-ONLY live adapter/harness around the existing AllyAdviceGenerator / AllyAdviceSemanticReviewer interfaces in lab/ (ally_generation_live.py plus optional ally_generation_scenarios.py and tests test_ally_generation_live.py / test_ally_generation_experiment.py), reuse the existing SAIRoute credential and transport discipline with no second secret store and no credential in artifacts, strict bounded JSON schemas on both sides with unknown/duplicate/missing field refusal and no repair prompt or second call, no chain-of-thought request, prove it in dry-run tests with zero network calls, and freeze the registration identity REGISTRATION_ID = sha256 of the canonical registration bytes before any live call. TARGET C: perform exactly ONE live run in the registered order of discovery, participant freeze, 4 scenarios x 2 role-swapped replicates, and 3 red controls x 2 participants, record every call record and product-outcome stage separately, write the immutable raw artifact lab/out/ally_generation_live_<stamp>.json, report lab/out/ALLY_GENERATION_REPORT_<stamp>.md and interpretation lab/analysis/ally_generation_<stamp>.md, update lab/LATEST.md additively, derive the experiment class and route identities from actual calls, keep denominators explicit, emit no overall model score or winner, then STOP. Never inspect real user or personal history, never call reviewed_ally_to_human_private / seal / HumanPrivateStore.deliver / attention admission, never produce a real private letter, never modify D-047/D-048 or production gate because of live outcomes, no retries or prompt tuning after results, no rank of models from n<=2 samples, no resume of T-34, no commit/tag/push/publish. Closure requires focused baseline 70 green plus the new lab tests, dry run proven zero-network, and saipen validate VALID.
